Title: Pacaso
Description: Fraction of a luxury home through co-ownership model.
Full description: Pacaso enables buyers to purchase a proportional share of a luxury property, allowing fractional home ownership instead of full acquisition.
Cos'è:
Pacaso is a real estate platform that allows individuals to purchase a share (fraction) of a luxury second home rather than buying the entire property.

Instead of owning 100% of a home, buyers typically purchase:

  • 1/8 share

  • 1/4 share

  • Or other proportional ownership

Each owner holds a legally structured share in an LLC that owns the property.

In some cases, crypto payments may be accepted depending on jurisdiction and transaction structure, but settlement typically follows regulated real estate processes.

Pacaso manages:

  • Scheduling

  • Maintenance

  • Property management

  • Legal structuring

This makes it different from traditional crypto real estate marketplaces.
Come funziona:
1. Browse available properties

  2. Choose ownership fraction

  3. Complete identity verification

  4. Finalize legal purchase of ownership share

  5. Use property according to scheduling system

Pacaso handles management, taxes, and operational coordination.

Crypto acceptance, when available, typically involves conversion during settlement.
quando usarlo:
Use Pacaso when you:

  • Want access to luxury property without full capital commitment

  • Prefer fractional real estate exposure

  • Seek managed co-ownership

  • Want structured legal clarity

Not ideal if you:

  • Want full private ownership

  • Avoid KYC

  • Expect fully on-chain property settlement

  • Want anonymous transactions

Title: CryptoRefills
Description: Buy gift cards and mobile refills using crypto.
Full description: CryptoRefills allows users to spend crypto on gift cards and prepaid services across multiple countries without using a bank or debit card.
Cos'è:
CryptoRefills is a cryptocurrency-based digital voucher platform that enables users to spend crypto on real-world services without needing a debit card or bank integration.

The platform supports hundreds of international brands across categories such as:

  • Retail

  • Gaming

  • Streaming services

  • Mobile operators

  • Prepaid services

Payments are processed instantly, and vouchers are delivered digitally within seconds.

It is widely used by crypto users who want:

  • Fast off-ramp alternative

  • No-KYC spending

  • International purchasing flexibility
Come funziona:
1. Select a brand or service

  2. Choose voucher amount

  3. Pay using supported cryptocurrency

  4. Receive the digital code instantly

Most purchases do not require account creation or KYC.

Crypto is converted at checkout and the voucher value reflects current market pricing including spread.

Use CryptoRefills when you:

  • Want to spend crypto without a debit card

  • Prefer no-KYC digital purchases

  • Need international brand access

  • Want fast settlement

Title: BTCMap
Description: Discover physical stores that accept Bitcoin
Full description: BTCMap is an open, community-driven directory that helps users locate real-world businesses accepting Bitcoin, especially via the Lightning Network.
Cos'è:
BTCMap is an open-source merchant discovery platform built for Bitcoin users. It provides a global map of businesses that accept Bitcoin payments, both on-chain and via Lightning Network.

Unlike crypto marketplaces or custodial services, BTCMap does not process payments, hold funds, or require accounts. It simply connects users with merchants that accept BTC.

The platform is community-maintained, meaning businesses can be added and verified by users.

It is particularly strong for:

  • Lightning Network adoption

  • Bitcoin circular economies

  • Crypto-native travelers

  • Privacy-focused users

BTCMap supports mobile browsing and location-based search, making it useful when traveling or exploring local BTC adoption.
Come funziona:
1. Open BTCMap in browser

  2. Allow location access or search manually

  3. View nearby merchants accepting BTC

  4. Pay directly using your own wallet

Payment methods typically include:

  • On-chain Bitcoin

  • Lightning Network

BTCMap itself does not handle the transaction.
quando usarlo:
Use BTCMap when you:

  • Travel and want to pay with BTC

  • Use Lightning frequently

  • Support Bitcoin adoption

  • Prefer direct wallet payments

Not ideal if you:

  • Want digital vouchers

  • Need fiat conversion

  • Want online-only spending tools

Title: Travala
Description: Book hotels and flights using crypto
Full description: Travala is a crypto-friendly travel booking platform that allows users to pay for hotels, flights and travel services using digital assets, while accessing global travel inventory through major industry partners.
Cos'è:
Travala is a global travel booking platform that integrates cryptocurrency payments into traditional travel infrastructure.

It provides access to:

  • Hotels

  • Flights

  • Travel packages

  • Activities

Travala aggregates inventory through established travel supply networks (similar to traditional booking platforms), allowing users to book mainstream accommodations while paying with crypto.

The platform supports a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including BTC, ETH, stablecoins and other major digital assets.

It also offers a loyalty program powered by the AVA token.
Come funziona:
1. Create account

  2. Search destination

  3. Select hotel or flight

  4. Choose payment method (crypto or fiat)

  5. Confirm booking

Crypto is converted at checkout and the merchant receives fiat settlement via Travala’s payment infrastructure.

The loyalty system may reward users with AVA tokens depending on tier.
quando usarlo:
Use Travala when you:

  • Want to book travel using crypto

  • Prefer mainstream hotel inventory

  • Travel internationally

  • Want loyalty rewards in crypto

Not ideal if you:

  • Want fully non-custodial payments

  • Avoid account creation

  • Need direct merchant settlement

Title: Courtyard
Description: Trade graded trading cards and collectibles as NFTs.
Full description: Courtyard is a marketplace and tokenization platform that lets users own and trade physical collectibles, primarily graded trading cards, as NFTs on the blockchain.
Cos'è:
Courtyard.io is a marketplace and tokenization service built on the Polygon network that allows collectors to turn physical collectibles, mainly graded trading cards such as Pokemon, sports, and gaming cards, into NFTs called Connected Collectibles.

Each physical item is verified, stored securely in a Brink's vault, and represented onchain by a digital twin that can be bought, sold, or redeemed.

Courtyard works for users who:

  • Want exposure to physical collectibles without storage or shipping hassles

  • Prefer instant, global liquidity for trading cards

  • Like the idea of provenance and ownership history recorded onchain

  • Are curious about real world assets (RWA) tokenization

Sellers also earn a 1% royalty every time their vaulted item is resold.
Come funziona:
1. Signup, Set up a crypto wallet compatible with Polygon

  2. Browse the marketplace or open digital packs to reveal cards

  3. Buy a Connected Collectible using crypto or a card payment

  4. The physical item stays insured and stored in a Brink's vault

  5. Trade the NFT anytime, or request physical redemption and shipping of the item

All ownership transfers and trade history are recorded onchain, giving full transparency on provenance.
quando usarlo:
Use Courtyard when you:

  • Collect or trade graded cards and want instant liquidity

  • Want to avoid shipping risk and storage costs

  • Are interested in tokenized real world assets

  • Want passive royalties on resold items

Not ideal if you:

  • Want to physically hold your collectibles at all times

  • Avoid platforms with custodial vaulting

  • Are not interested in trading cards or graded collectibles

Title: CryptoRealEstate
Description: Buy and sell real estate using crypto.
Full description: CryptoRealEstate.cc is a global property listing platform connecting buyers and sellers interested in completing real estate transactions using cryptocurrency.
Cos'è:
CryptoRealEstate.cc is an international property listing portal designed specifically for crypto users looking to buy or sell real estate using digital assets.

The platform acts as a bridge between:

  • Crypto holders

  • Real estate agents

  • Property owners

While listings are crypto-friendly, transactions must comply with local property laws, meaning full KYC and legal documentation are required.

Crypto may be:

  • Accepted directly by seller

  • Converted into fiat during escrow

  • Processed via intermediary services

It operates more as a listing and brokerage network rather than a fully automated crypto-native real estate protocol.
Come funziona:
1. Browse global property listings

  2. Contact seller or agent

  3. Negotiate price in crypto or fiat equivalent

  4. Complete legal verification and KYC

  5. Finalize transaction via escrow or direct settlement

The legal transfer of ownership follows local jurisdiction requirements.
quando usarlo:
Use CryptoRealEstate.cc when you:

  • Want to buy property with crypto

  • Look for international real estate options

  • Are comfortable with legal compliance

  • Need a crypto-focused property network

Not ideal if you:

  • Want anonymous real estate purchases

  • Avoid formal escrow and legal processes

  • Expect fully on-chain property settlement
